scope: Conceptual bench-only thermal vest; not cleared for human use
decisions: Torso-mounted vest; 2 conceptual modules sharing 1 A peak budget, not 1 A each.
PCM on hot-side buffer concept, exact thermal interfaces TBD.
No real component envelopes, safe temperature thresholds, battery ratings or TEC performance curves assumed verified.
unresolved: Actual part selection and electrical design, heat rejection, PCM transition temperature and latent heat, fabric fit and pressure, independent over-temperature protection, skin-contact safety, current/voltage protection, battery/charger compatibility, empirical bench testing.
